articles.title: KPC Group’s Oceanwide Plaza Bet Started With a Supertall Dream for Manhattan
articles.narrative: KPC Group has acquired the unfinished Oceanwide Plaza mixed-use development in Downtown Los Angeles for $517 million in cash and credit, following a bankruptcy court approval. The firm plans to complete the 2 million-square-foot project, which includes hotel, residential, and retail components, with an estimated total cost of $850 million or more. The acquisition marks a significant step for KPC Group's founder, Dr. Kali Chaudhuri, in developing a trophy property in a major U.S. market, despite the project's history of stalled construction and financing challenges. The firm is currently focused on cleaning up extensive graffiti on the property and securing entitlements within a six-month deadline.

data_points.notable_features: Will feature a massive LED screen adjacent to Crypto.com Arena and L.A. Live, envisioned as the 'Times Square of Los Angeles'.
data_points.project_notes: The project stalled approximately seven years ago and became known for its graffiti-covered exterior. KPC Group acquired the EB-5 loan for the project after it went into default, which later gave them priority to bid in the bankruptcy auction. The firm is keeping the original design to expedite entitlements.

articles.title: Aggregate Buys $58M Northern Virginia Portfolio
articles.narrative: Aggregate Real Estate Investors has acquired an 11-building industrial and retail portfolio in Northern Virginia from Clarke-Hook Corporation for $58 million. The 320,000-square-foot portfolio, which was 94% leased to over 90 tenants at the time of sale, includes properties in Fairfax and Loudoun counties. Aggregate plans aesthetic upgrades and new management initiatives to create additional value, aligning with their strategy to target value-add deals in the Mid-Atlantic region.

data_points.notable_features: Portfolio includes West Fairfax Commerce Center, University Commerce Center, Dulles Trade Center, and McLean Commerce Center.
data_points.project_notes: The portfolio was 94% leased to more than 90 tenants at the time of the transaction.

articles.title: Dwight Supplies $70M Refi on Newark Multifamily Tower
articles.narrative: New Jersey developer Yisroel Berger has secured a $70 million nonrecourse, interest-only loan from Dwight Investment Management to refinance the newly redeveloped Cosmo 440, a 216-unit multifamily tower in Newark, NJ. The 25-story building, which was gut-renovated after sitting vacant for a decade, has been transformed into an amenity-rich community with 26 units designated as affordable housing. The refinancing marks the project's transition from its construction phase and lease-up to a stabilized asset, strategically located near transit and Newark Liberty International Airport.

data_points.notable_features: 26 units set aside as affordable housing; amenities include a concierge, coworking lounge, fitness center, playground, and parking garage with electric vehicle charging.
data_points.project_notes: The development previously received a $60 million loan from BridgeInvest last year for gut renovation of the building.

articles.title: Cortland Sells West Palm Rental at Discount for $208M
articles.narrative: Fairfield Residential acquired the 812-unit Portofino Place Apartments in West Palm Beach, FL, from Cortland for $208 million. The transaction, which closed through two deeds, represents a discount for the seller compared to its 2021 purchase price. The buyer assumed two Freddie Mac-backed loans totaling over $178 million as part of the financing.

data_points.address: 4400 and 4600 Portofino Way, West Palm Beach, FL
data_points.project_notes: The property was previously acquired by Cortland for $229 million in 2021. The sale occurred through two deeds: one for $108 million covering 416 units built in 2003, and another for $100 million covering 396 units built in 2006.

articles.title: Westbridge Realty Group Files Plans for Three 99-Unit Buildings in the Bronx
articles.narrative: Westbridge Realty Group has filed plans for three new residential buildings in the Soundview neighborhood of the Bronx, totaling 297 units. Each building is designed with 99 units, a common strategy among developers to qualify for the city's 485-x tax incentive while avoiding costly construction wage mandates associated with projects of 100 units or more. The proposed developments include significant commercial space, indicating a mixed-use approach.

data_points.address: 851 Rosedale Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Each building will include commercial space and rooftop space.
data_points.project_notes: The projects are designed with 99 units each, likely to benefit from the 485-x tax abatement without triggering construction wage mandates for projects with 100 or more units.

articles.title: Partnership Refinances 408-Unit Multifamily Property in Princeton, Texas
articles.narrative: A partnership between Core Spaces and Harrison Street Asset Management has refinanced Oxenfree at Princeton, a 408-unit multifamily property located in Princeton, Texas. The community, completed in late 2025, features a mix of rentable townhomes and detached single-family homes. Newmark arranged the undisclosed loan amount through GID.

data_points.notable_features: Offers a mix of rentable townhomes and detached single-family homes with private outdoor spaces and attached garages, and includes a pool, fitness center, sports court, and coworking space.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 316-Unit Apartment Complex in Fort Worth
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of Trinity Heights, a 316-unit apartment complex in Fort Worth. The 25-building property, built in 1985, features one- and two-bedroom units averaging 850 square feet. Marcus & Millichap represented the seller and procured the buyer, NeuRock Capital.

data_points.address: 6501 Boca Raton Blvd, Fort Worth, TX
data_points.notable_features: Amenities include multiple pools, a fitness center, playground, and onsite laundry facilities.

articles.title: JLL Arranges Loan for Refinancing of Industrial Complex in San Marcos, Texas
articles.narrative: JLL has arranged a bridge loan for Denholtz Properties to refinance Clovis Crossing, a 213,125-square-foot industrial complex in San Marcos, Texas. The property, acquired by Denholtz in 2024, is strategically located between Austin and San Antonio. Argentic Investment Management provided the financing.

data_points.address: 1603 Clovis Barker Rd, San Marcos, TX
data_points.notable_features: Two-building property with 32-foot clear heights, 60 dock doors, four drive-in ramps, and 233 car parking spaces.
data_points.project_notes: Property was previously acquired by Denholtz Properties in 2024.

articles.title: Kent Cos. Signs 39,894 SF Industrial Lease in Northeast Austin
articles.narrative: Kent Cos., a Michigan-based provider of specialty concrete services, has signed a 39,894-square-foot industrial lease in northeast Austin. The company will relocate and expand its regional operations to Tuscany X Crossing Business Park, a 329,627-square-foot industrial development. The new location offers strategic access, being situated two miles north of I-35.

data_points.notable_features: Located two miles north of I-35.

articles.title: Phoenix Investors’ Affiliate Acquires 1.8 MSF Industrial Complex in Saginaw, Michigan
articles.narrative: An affiliate of Phoenix Investors has acquired a 1.8 million-square-foot industrial complex in Buena Vista Charter Township, bordering Saginaw, Michigan, from international auto supplier Nexteer Automotive. The complex comprises three buildings, with Nexteer Automotive continuing to occupy nearly 1.3 million square feet in two of the facilities. Approximately 552,000 square feet in the third building is available for lease, aligning with Phoenix Investors' strategy of revitalizing former manufacturing sites.

data_points.project_notes: Nexteer Automotive will continue to occupy nearly 1.3 million square feet across Plants 6/1 and 7. Approximately 552,000 square feet in Plant 5 is currently available for lease.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap sells PNC Bank property in San Antonio
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has facilitated the sale of a newly constructed PNC Bank ground lease property in San Antonio. The property, an outparcel to a Sam's Club within the Stone Oak trade area, was marketed by Marcus & Millichap on behalf of a Texas-based developer and acquired by a private investor. The transaction involves a new 20-year ground lease with scheduled rent increases, capitalizing on the area's ongoing residential, multifamily, and mixed-use development.

data_points.notable_features: Outparcel to Sam's Club within the Stone Oak trade area, secured by a new 20-year ground lease with 10% rent increases every five years.

articles.title: CanTex Capital acquires 18,535-square-foot industrial building in New Braunfels
articles.narrative: CanTex Capital has acquired an 18,535-square-foot industrial building in New Braunfels, Texas, marking its first investment in the Austin-San Antonio corridor. The property, situated on six acres, includes industrial outdoor storage (IOS) and is fully leased to a national tenant. This acquisition aligns with CanTex Capital's strategy to expand its portfolio of IOS assets in Texas markets with high barriers to entry, capitalizing on the property's strategic location and scarcity of similar assets.

data_points.notable_features: Includes industrial outdoor storage (IOS) and offers visibility and access along the primary freight and population corridor connecting Austin and San Antonio.

articles.title: Core Spaces delivers 6,000 new student housing beds at colleges across country
articles.narrative: Core Spaces has delivered approximately 6,000 new student housing beds across six purpose-built student housing communities, completing all projects ahead of schedule for the 2026 academic year. These developments expand Core's national portfolio in Tier 1 university markets, emphasizing thoughtful design, innovation, and a hospitality-driven approach to student living. The successful and early delivery of these large-scale communities highlights the strength of Core's integrated platform and the disciplined execution of its development, construction, and operational teams.

data_points.project_notes: All six projects were completed at least six weeks ahead of move-in and under budget.

articles.title: Indianapolis’ Premier Commercial Real Estate Services hires broker associate
Enverra Real Estate Partners acquires four-building office portfolio in Minneaoplis
articles.narrative: Enverra Real Estate Partners has acquired the West End Office Park, a four-building Class A office portfolio in Minneapolis, MN. The portfolio, approximately 90% leased with a strong tenant mix, is strategically located at the intersection of I-394 and Highway 100, offering convenient access to both the urban core and affluent western suburbs. Enverra plans a $7 million capital improvement program to enhance the tenant experience with hospitality-driven amenities and a dedicated Tenant Experience Manager.

data_points.notable_features: Class A office portfolio located at the intersection of I-394 and Highway 100, offering access to the urban core and western suburbs.
data_points.project_notes: Enverra plans a $7 million capital and amenity program to upgrade common areas, fitness offerings, food and beverage amenities, outdoor spaces, and tenant gathering areas, along with a new spec suite program and a dedicated Tenant Experience Manager.

articles.title: SVN Chicago Commercial Facilitates Sale of Property in Chicago’s Noble Square Neighborhood
articles.narrative: SVN Chicago Commercial facilitated the sale of a six-unit Greystone and coach house property in Chicago's Noble Square neighborhood for $1.56 million. The value-add property generated significant buyer interest, receiving multiple offers and ultimately selling above its asking price. The strong demand for the asset highlights the competitive market for well-located multifamily opportunities in established Chicago neighborhoods.

data_points.notable_features: Includes a Greystone building and a coach house; located in the Noble Square neighborhood.
data_points.project_notes: Value-add property that sold above asking price due to competitive buyer interest.

articles.title: CBRE Arranges $11M Refinancing for Minnesota Office Property
articles.narrative: CBRE Capital Markets has arranged an $11 million refinancing package for Grandview Square, a fully occupied office property in Edina, Minnesota. The five-year, fixed-rate, interest-only loan was secured on behalf of Capital Partners, the property's owner. The property's strong fundamentals, including full occupancy, a diverse tenant mix, and consistent owner reinvestment, attracted competitive interest from lenders.

data_points.notable_features: Renovated in 2025, the property offers a variety of amenities and is located in Edina's Grandview district with convenient access to downtown Minneapolis, Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport, and the 50th & France retail corridor.

articles.title: Vivmark Merger Triggers $742M in Bay Area Apartment Acquisitions
articles.narrative: Vivmark Residential affiliates have acquired seven apartment complexes across the South Bay and East Bay for a total of $741.8 million, encompassing 1,843 units. This significant portfolio acquisition was triggered by the merger of AvalonBay Communities and Equity Residential, indicating a strategic realignment of assets in the Bay Area multifamily market.

articles.title: Proposed Energy, Digital Infrastructure Project in Pennsylvania Advances
articles.narrative: A proposed energy and digital infrastructure project, Salem 3, in Northeastern Pennsylvania, has advanced through the approvals process with the Salem Township Planning Commission recommending an expansion of the data center overlay district. This recommendation paves the way for over 200 landowners to pursue a potential $1.4 billion land sale involving more than 4,000 acres. The project aims to combine existing energy infrastructure with new data center and digital infrastructure investments, including privately funded power generation and infrastructure improvements.

data_points.notable_features: Approximately 3,000 acres will be preserved as natural buffers, green space, and setbacks.
data_points.project_notes: The project involves pairing existing energy infrastructure with new data center and digital infrastructure investment, requiring significant privately funded power generation and infrastructure improvements.

articles.title: Advertising Agency Havas Health Expands to 250K-Plus SF in Grand Central District
articles.narrative: Havas Health, an advertising agency, has significantly expanded its headquarters at 200 Madison Avenue in New York City's Grand Central district. The firm added 64,657 square feet, bringing its total footprint to 254,118 square feet across five floors. This expansion is coupled with a 15-year lease extension, securing Havas Health's presence in the building through 2041. The landlord noted that the long-term commitment reflects the appeal of the tower's amenity-rich environment.

data_points.address: 200 Madison Ave, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Premier Grand Central district office tower with a hospitality-focused, amenity-rich environment.
data_points.project_notes: Lease expansion of 64,657 square feet, combined with a 15-year extension through 2041.

articles.title: Healey Awards $15M To Help Advance 5 Residential Conversion Projects
articles.narrative: Governor Maura Healey has allocated $15.3 million in funding to support five distinct residential conversion projects across Massachusetts. These projects are anticipated to collectively deliver 856 new housing units, contributing to the state's housing supply initiatives.

data_points.project_notes: Funding awarded to help advance five residential conversion projects.

articles.title: Buyer Of BXP's Sumner Square Revealed: The D.C. Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: The D.C. Deal Sheet reports on several transactions, including the sale of Sumner Square by BXP, a new anchor lease in downtown D.C. by Sheppard, and Douglas Development's sale of a Georgetown building. The Sheppard lease is expected to trigger a renovation of the leased space.

articles.title: Laramar Group Pays $166M For 43-Story South Loop Apartment Building
articles.narrative: Laramar Group has acquired a 656-unit apartment building in Chicago's South Loop for $166 million. This transaction represents the first change in ownership for the 43-story property since 1967.

articles.title: Wellness Spa Proposed At Former Greyhound Site: The Denver Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Circle Wellness is planning to develop a new wellness spa in Denver, Colorado. The project will be located on a 1-acre site that previously housed a Greyhound maintenance facility.

data_points.project_notes: The site previously housed a Greyhound maintenance facility.

articles.title: Law Firms Are On A Historic Office Binge
articles.narrative: Law firms are driving significant office demand across major U.S. metropolitan areas, having leased 12.2 million square feet in 2026. This surge in activity is contributing to a robust office market, particularly in key legal hubs. The trend indicates a strong commitment by law firms to physical office space, defying some broader market uncertainties.
